claims.claim_text: Aletheia implements a deterministic visibility-safe project core from authorized import through non-causal lineage closeout.
minimum_evidence: hash, visibility, tamper and cross-platform gates
claims.scope_boundary: This is an engineering closeout for the project core; retention, purge, prospective sealing, Projmem integration and causal correctness are excluded.
claims.falsifier_or_downgrade: Any unreconciled role, stale hash, cross-project edge, visibility inversion or causal lineage edge blocks the closeout claim.
claims.allowed_wording: The named release implements and verifies the documented project-core persistence-lineage contract.
forbidden_wording: the project lifecycle is fully complete

claims.claim_text: Evidence-conditioned diagnosis was technically feasible in the frozen directional pilot.
claims.unit_of_analysis: case family with matched evidence-condition outputs
claims.denominator: 5 paired families nested in one data-drift mechanism
claims.scope_boundary: The result is a small directional pilot within one mechanism and cannot establish powered superiority or cross-domain generality.
claims.falsifier_or_downgrade: Closeout hash failure, incomplete output census, unresolved human reconciliation or material evaluator leakage withdraws the pilot claim.
claims.allowed_wording: The frozen pilot provides a bounded directional feasibility signal.

claims.claim_text: Label-noise evidence is assumption-limited after the registered v3.3 outcome.
claims.scope_boundary: The completed study does not permit a cross-dataset causal-diagnosis claim and may be evaluated only through prespecified assumption-limited endpoints.
claims.falsifier_or_downgrade: A missing or mismatched v3.3 terminal store, protocol binding or disposition receipt withdraws this bounded interpretation.
claims.allowed_wording: Label noise remains assumption-limited, with no cross-dataset admission claim.

claims.claim_text: The terminal primary causal-diagnosis track is empty because no implemented mechanism passed every prespecified mechanism-specific admission gate.
claims.unit_of_analysis: mechanism with a completed registered study
claims.scope_boundary: Implementation, merge and CI status do not constitute scientific admission; non-admitted mechanisms cannot enter causal-diagnosis scoring.
claims.falsifier_or_downgrade: Any mismatch among terminal outcomes, disposition policy and the diagnosis mechanism routing manifest blocks downstream evaluation rather than changing the denominator.
claims.allowed_wording: The terminal admitted set is empty and the empty primary track must be reported.
forbidden_wording: two mechanisms were admitted because their code merged
three implemented mechanisms equal three admitted mechanisms

claims.claim_text: Three mechanism types have implemented fail-closed candidate, intervention, evidence and lifecycle contracts.
minimum_evidence: merged mechanism validators and lifecycle contracts
claims.scope_boundary: Implemented instrument breadth is distinct from confirmatory admission and diagnostic ground truth.
claims.falsifier_or_downgrade: A mechanism lacking a validated intervention, evidence siblings, controls, provenance binding or lifecycle contract is removed from the implemented inventory.
claims.allowed_wording: Aletheia contains three implemented mechanism types with fail-closed contracts.
forbidden_wording: three of three mechanisms are confirmatory-admitted

claims.claim_text: The registered instrument-validity study v1.2 achieved its manipulation dose, but neither studied mechanism passed the target-effect, direction and paired-instrument admission chain.
minimum_evidence: complete terminal store, measurement census and mechanism closeouts
claims.unit_of_analysis: mechanism by named dataset by registered seed
claims.scope_boundary: The result rejects the two registered instruments within the named study; it does not establish universal mechanism ineffectiveness.
claims.falsifier_or_downgrade: Any terminal-store hash mismatch, incomplete paired census, protocol deviation or partial outcome release invalidates the negative-result claim.
claims.allowed_wording: Both registered instruments were rejected within the named study, yielding a valid negative construct-validity result.
forbidden_wording: the registered instrument-validity study v1.2 was a technical failure
zero of two means the benchmark system failed

claims.claim_text: Aletheia addresses a bounded combination-and-evaluation gap across evidence visibility, claim support, abstention, paired interventions and immutable lineage.
claims.unit_of_analysis: work in the prespecified reviewed corpus
claims.scope_boundary: The statement is a scoped review result, not a universal priority or first-in-the-world claim.
claims.falsifier_or_downgrade: Discovery of a reviewed predecessor implementing and evaluating the complete bounded construct set requires narrowing or withdrawing the combination-gap wording.
claims.allowed_wording: Among the prespecified reviewed works, no single evaluated system combined all tested elements.
forbidden_wording: Aletheia is the first system in the world
Aletheia is the only evidence-grounded diagnosis system

forbidden_public_patterns.rationale: Implemented inventory must not be substituted for the zero admitted denominator.
The completed v1.2 terminal study is a valid negative scientific result.
Only the named project-core generation has closed.
Novelty is bounded to the prespecified reviewed corpus.
No current result supports universal comparative superiority.
